question:
Assertion (A): Electric field lines are always perpendicular to equipotential surfaces.
Reason (R): No work is done in moving a test charge along an equipotential surface, implying the force (and thus the field) has no component along the displacement.

options.A: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A.
options.B: Both A and R are true but R is NOT the correct explanation of A.
options.C: A is true but R is false.
options.D: A is false but R is true.
